author: VIREAL
title: Hiring 3D Artist for MiniEmpires
content:
We're hiring a 3D Artist for #MiniEmpires!

You'll design stylized, optimized assets including units, vehicles, buildings, and skins while working closely with the game's art direction.

📩 Send your portfolio via DM to apply!
🔗 See requirements below.

#RobloxDev #Roblox

Requirements: Be 18+ years old. Have 2+ years of relevant experience. Follow a Sketch -> Model -> Texture workflow. Communicate consistently and professionally. Be proficient in Blender and Adobe software. Create clean, optimized game-ready assets.
